correctness.rationale: The exact 94-tetrahedron complex reconstructs f=(16,110,188,94). Contracting a fixed spanning tree gives 95 graph-cycle generators. Deterministic unimodular row/column reduction of the 188 facial relations yields 93 unit pivots and zero residual block, proving H1 is free of rank two. Two explicit integer cocycles annihilate every facial relation and pair as a unimodular coordinate basis on two cycles. Exhaustion of all 449 graph triangles gives 188 faces and 261 nonfaces, with exact up-to-sign homology counts 43 null, 86 of (0,1), 66 of (1,1), 65 of (1,0), and one of (1,2). Every nonzero vector is primitive.

value.rationale: For a flat three-manifold with H1=Z^2, the first nonzero simple-cycle layer is a natural combinatorial stable-norm analogue. The complete result is structurally nonuniform: 218 shortest primitive cycles occupy only four unoriented classes, and one of those classes has a unique shortest representative. This refines the known homology and face vector by an inclusion-sensitive exact invariant.
